_comment: Simple-English narration for the live demo videos, one line per step. Key = <chapter folder>/<step name slug> as the harnesses write it (lower case, non-alphanumerics -> '-'). null = the step is left out of the video (internal set-up or a duplicate).
01-admin-setup/sign-in-as-admin: This is the desktop app. The admin types the user name and the password, and signs in.
01-admin-setup/dashboard: After sign in, the admin sees the dashboard. It shows today's sales, orders and tables, live.
01-admin-setup/users-list: Users. Here is every staff member, with their role.
01-admin-setup/new-user-dialog: To add a waiter, the admin types a user name, a display name and a password, and picks the role.
01-admin-setup/create-user: Press Create. The new waiter is added, and can sign in on a phone right away.
01-admin-setup/roles-permissions: Roles and permissions. Each role is a list of the things it is allowed to do, grouped by area.
01-admin-setup/devices: Devices. Every terminal, phone and tablet that has signed in is listed here, with its licence seat.
01-admin-setup/sections: Sections and tables. First the dining areas, like the hall, the patio or the rooftop.
01-admin-setup/tables: Then the tables. Each table has a code, a name, the number of seats, and its section.
01-admin-setup/floor-plan-section: The floor plan. The tables of a section are shown on a map.
01-admin-setup/floor-plan-select-a-tile: Click a table to select it.
01-admin-setup/floor-plan-rotate-and-sha: You can turn it, make it round or square, and move it.
01-admin-setup/floor-plan-save: Press Save. Every phone and terminal gets the new map at once.
01-admin-setup/menu-categories: The menu. Categories first, in the order they show on the phone.
01-admin-setup/menu-items: Items, with the price, the tax, the kitchen station, and whether the item is available.
01-admin-setup/menu-item-editor: Editing an item. Change the price, the tax, the station, or the picture.
01-admin-setup/menu-modifiers: Modifiers. Add-ons and choices, like the spice level or extra raita.
01-admin-setup/payments-discounts: Payment methods and discounts. Cash, card, UPI and wallet, and the discount rules.
01-admin-setup/restaurant-settings: Restaurant settings. The name, the address, the GST number, and how bills are numbered.
01-admin-setup/printers: Printers. Which printer prints the kitchen ticket, and which one prints the bill.
01-admin-setup/expense-categories: Expense categories, for the daily costs the cashier records.
01-admin-setup/licence: Licence. How many terminals can be used, and when the licence ends.
01-admin-setup/server: Server. The admin checks the server health and the disk space from here.
01-admin-setup/backup: Backup. The server takes a backup every night. A backup can also be made or restored here.
01-admin-setup/audit-log: The audit log. Every change is recorded, with who did it and from which terminal.
01-admin-setup/command-palette: Press Control K to jump to any screen by typing its name.
01-admin-setup/dark-theme: The app also has a dark theme.
04-cashier-desktop/sign-in-as-cashier1: Now the cashier. The cashier signs in on the billing terminal.
04-cashier-desktop/waiter-and-kitchen-pr: Meanwhile, a waiter has taken an order on table 5 and a takeaway order from a phone. The kitchen has cooked them, and the guests have asked for the bill.
04-cashier-desktop/cashier-home: The cashier home. It shows the shift, the bills waiting, and the day's totals.
04-cashier-desktop/open-shift: First, open the shift. The cashier counts the cash in the drawer and confirms.
04-cashier-desktop/queue-with-a-takeaway: Billing. The queue lists every bill that is waiting. The takeaway order is here too.
04-cashier-desktop/queue-takeaway-chip: Tap Takeaway to see only the takeaway bills.
04-cashier-desktop/workspace-with-a-bill: Select the table 5 bill. On the right are the items, the taxes and the total.
04-cashier-desktop/discount: A discount. Five percent for a regular guest. The total updates at once.
04-cashier-desktop/finalize: Finalize. The invoice gets its number and prints. Here the printer is off, so the job waits in the print queue.
04-cashier-desktop/cash-payment-f2: Press F2 for cash. Type what the guest gives, and the change is shown.
04-cashier-desktop/split-payment: Split payment. Part in cash, the rest by card, with a reference.
04-cashier-desktop/wallet-payment: Now the takeaway bill. The guest pays with a wallet. The cashier types the wallet reference.
04-cashier-desktop/paid-state: Confirm. The bill is paid and closed.
04-cashier-desktop/print-receipt: Print the receipt for the guest.
04-cashier-desktop/queue-paid-chip: Tap Paid to see the bills that are done.
04-cashier-desktop/closed-bills: Closed bills. Every bill of the day, with a search.
04-cashier-desktop/print-log: The print log. A failed print can be printed again from here.
04-cashier-desktop/pay-out: Pay out. The cashier takes 450 rupees from the drawer for vegetables, with a reason.
04-cashier-desktop/expenses-list: Expenses. The daily costs of the restaurant.
04-cashier-desktop/record-expense-dialog: Record an expense: the category, the amount, who was paid, and a note.
04-cashier-desktop/expense-recorded: Saved. The expense shows in the list, and in the manager's reports.
04-cashier-desktop/x-report: The X report. A summary of the shift so far: sales, payments, and the cash in the drawer.
04-cashier-desktop/notifications-bell: The bell. Messages from the kitchen and the floor arrive here.
04-cashier-desktop/close-shift: Close the shift. The cashier counts the drawer. If it is short, a reason is recorded.
05-manager-desktop/sign-in-as-manager1: Now the manager. The manager can use any terminal.
05-manager-desktop/dashboard: The dashboard. Sales, orders, the average order value, tables in use, expenses today, sales by hour, and who is on duty right now.
05-manager-desktop/orders-page: Orders. Every order of the day, live, with its status.
05-manager-desktop/new-reservation-form: A new reservation: the table, the guest name, how many people, and the time.
05-manager-desktop/reservation-created: Press Create. The table shows as reserved on every phone.
05-manager-desktop/seat-reservation: When the guests arrive, press Seat. The table is now in use.
05-manager-desktop/tables-map-mode: Tables on the map, with their live status.
05-manager-desktop/tables-list-mode: The same tables as a list.
05-manager-desktop/kitchen-display: The kitchen display, as the kitchen sees it.
05-manager-desktop/report-hourly-sales: Hourly sales, to see the busy hours.
05-manager-desktop/report-profit-loss: Profit and loss: sales minus expenses.
05-manager-desktop/report-payments: Payments by method: cash, card, UPI and wallet.
05-manager-desktop/export-excel: Any report can be saved to Excel.
05-manager-desktop/day-end-pre-check: Day end. The app checks that every shift is closed and every bill is paid, before the day is closed.
05-manager-desktop/gst-current-month: GST. The tax return for the month, ready to file.
05-manager-desktop/audit-log-filter: The audit log, filtered by user and action. Here, every discount the cashier gave.
05-manager-desktop/dark-dashboard: The dashboard in the dark theme.
02-waiter-phone/sign-in-screen: This is the phone app. The waiter picks Waiter, and types the user name and the password.
02-waiter-phone/home-with-kpis: Home. The waiter sees the tables in use, the open orders, and today's numbers.
02-waiter-phone/tables-in-list-mode: Tables as a list, with the status of each table.
02-waiter-phone/list-shows-the-reservati: Filter by section. A reserved table shows a badge.
02-waiter-phone/tables-in-map-mode-groun: Or see the tables on the floor map.
02-waiter-phone/map-mode-section-without: A section without a map still shows its tables.
02-waiter-phone/table-details-dp1-with-t: Open a table. It has a reservation for tonight.
02-waiter-phone/seat-the-reservation: The guests have arrived. Tap Seat.
02-waiter-phone/new-order-screen-with-th: New order. Dine in, takeaway, or delivery.
02-waiter-phone/favourites: Star the items you sell the most. Favourites are always one tap away.
02-waiter-phone/item-options-sheet-with-: Tap an item. Pick the add-ons and the spice level, and type a note for the kitchen.
02-waiter-phone/cart-bar-after-adding-th: Add more items. The cart bar shows the count and the total.
02-waiter-phone/review-sheet: Review the order. Change the quantities and add a note.
02-waiter-phone/send-to-kitchen: Send to kitchen. The kitchen tablet gets the ticket at once.
02-waiter-phone/order-details-kitchen-ti: The order details show the kitchen tickets.
02-waiter-phone/print-kot-button-pressed: The kitchen ticket can be printed from the phone.
02-waiter-phone/items-tab-with-the-note: The items tab shows every item, with its note.
02-waiter-phone/takeaway-order-builder-n: A takeaway order. No table is needed.
02-waiter-phone/send-the-takeaway-order: Add the items, and send it to the kitchen.
02-waiter-phone/save-a-draft-from-a-new-: If the guest is not sure yet, save the order as a draft.
02-waiter-phone/held-tab-lists-the-saved: Drafts are kept in the Held tab.
02-waiter-phone/resume-the-held-order: Tap Resume to continue the order.
02-waiter-phone/send-the-resumed-order: And send it to the kitchen.
02-waiter-phone/my-orders-active: My orders. Every open order of this waiter.
02-waiter-phone/takeaway-order-details: The takeaway order, with its status.
02-waiter-phone/bell-panel: The bell. The waiter is told when the food is ready.
02-waiter-phone/dark-theme: The dark theme, for evening service.
02-waiter-phone/my-orders-shows-ready: Back on the waiter's phone. The order shows Ready.
02-waiter-phone/mark-served: The waiter serves the food, and taps Mark served.
02-waiter-phone/request-the-bill: The guests ask for the bill. Tap Request bill. The cashier sees it at once.
02-waiter-phone/bell-with-the-ready-noti: The bell keeps the ready message.
02-waiter-phone/offline-banner: If the Wi-Fi drops, the app shows a banner, but keeps working.
02-waiter-phone/my-orders-while-offline: The waiter can still see the orders.
02-waiter-phone/back-online: When the network is back, everything syncs by itself.
03-kitchen-tablet/sign-in-screen: This is the kitchen tablet. The cook picks Kitchen, and signs in.
03-kitchen-tablet/board-with-kpi-strip-a: The kitchen board. New tickets on the left, cooking in the middle, ready on the right.
03-kitchen-tablet/the-dp1-and-takeaway-t: The table order and the takeaway order have arrived.
03-kitchen-tablet/ticket-detail-pane-wit: Tap a ticket. It shows every item, with a picture and the waiter's note.
03-kitchen-tablet/station-page-show-item: Station settings. Each tablet can show only its own station, and show pictures on the cards.
03-kitchen-tablet/board-with-thumbnails-: The board, with pictures on the cards.
03-kitchen-tablet/start-preparing: Start cooking. The waiter can see that the order is being prepared.
03-kitchen-tablet/mark-ready: Mark it ready. The waiter's phone rings.
03-kitchen-tablet/bell-panel: The bell shows the kitchen's messages.
03-kitchen-tablet/dark-theme: The dark theme for the kitchen.
